key_features.architecture: Hierarchical planning system with intention→goal→plan→execution transformation

core_functionality.intention_extraction: Transforms user input into structured intentions
core_functionality.goal_creation: Creates goals from extracted intentions with entity resolution
core_functionality.domain_memory: Manages persistent knowledge of entities, applications, and user preferences
core_functionality.conversation_tracking: Maintains conversation history with planning metadata
core_functionality.compatibility: Maintains backward compatibility with legacy alias system

persistence.domain_knowledge: Separates conversational memory from permanent knowledge
persistence.user_preferences: Tracks and learns from user interactions
persistence.execution_events: Records command usage for predictive analysis

integration_points.entity_resolver: Advanced entity resolution with context awareness

compatibility_features.legacy_aliases: Maintains command alias system from previous versions
compatibility_features.conversation_history: Preserves legacy conversation format when needed
